_about: The laws. tolerance_cents is absolute unless noted. severity: stop scopes a number out until fixed; hold shows it with a warning. Every result can be accepted by a decision with a reason and a reopen_if, so an old lodged year or an accountant's judgement does not leave the page red for ever. A new law starts at hold for one release.

L1.name: Conservation
L1.claim: Every event's postings sum to zero.

L2.name: Clearing
L2.claim: Every clearing account is zero at close, or each open item has an age and a named missing witness.

L3.name: Continuity
L3.claim: For every statement, opening plus movements equals closing, and each closing is the next opening, on ledger-fidelity accounts.
L3.detail: A missing statement is a gap: scoped to that account and period, shown with coverage. A statement that contradicts the lines we hold is a fail, scoped the same way. Neither withholds the household's views. Snapshot accounts are exempt: their stated balance is their balance.

L4.name: One claim
L4.claim: Every active observation of an event-bearing kind is attached to exactly one event as recogniser, or is a clearing or corroborating witness, or is excluded by a decision.

L5.name: Payslip
L5.claim: Gross less sacrifice, tax and deductions, plus allowances and reimbursements, equals net; year-to-date chains; the year's payslips sum to the income statement.

L6.name: Interest
L6.claim: Interest charged is within tolerance of daily interest at the rate valid each day, net of offset.

L7.name: Holdings
L7.claim: Open lots equal the units a broker states, per instrument and date, on ledger-fidelity holdings.
L7.detail: A snapshot holding is exempt: a holdings statement with no trade history opens lots with cost_known false, so a later sale reports an unknown gain, never a full one.

L8.name: Roll-forward
L8.claim: Net worth as posted equals net worth as stated by sources, month by month, wherever every account in scope has a stated balance or valuation. The identity change-in-net-worth = income - expenses + revaluation holds by construction under L1; this law tests it against independent evidence.

L9.name: Ownership
L9.claim: Shares sum to 100% per subject, basis and day.

L10.name: Timeline
L10.claim: No overlapping valid ranges for one subject and term; required terms have no gaps.

L11.name: Tax tie
L11.claim: The derived return agrees with the lodged return and notice of assessment, label by label.

L12.name: Seal
L12.claim: A locked period's hash has not changed.

L13.name: Coverage
L13.claim: Every stream has what it should for the period.

L14.name: Super tie
L14.claim: Contributions on payslips reach the fund, allowing for its lag.
L14.detail: Lag: 28 days after quarter end until 30 June 2026; 7 business days under payday super from 1 July 2026.

L15.name: Provenance
L15.claim: Every event cites an observation, and every observation a source with a hash.

L16.name: Cap
L16.claim: Contributions and thresholds sit within the law for that date, or raise an item.

L17.name: Bound
L17.claim: Every decision resolves to a target that exists after this rebuild. An orphan goes to review and is never dropped.

L18.name: One level
L18.claim: A dollar counts at one level: an asset owned by a wrapper (SMSF, trust, company) is not counted beside the wrapper's balance. The overlap is named and only the duplicated amount is scoped out. Look-through is a view, not a second count.

L19.name: BAS sales tie
L19.claim: Net sales on the year's activity statements tie to business income on the return: G1 less 1A when G1 includes GST, G1 when it does not. Statements with no G1 are skipped.
L19.detail: Raises a question, not a conservation failure: a return can hold non-sales income and sit on a different accounting basis.

L20.name: Plausibility
L20.claim: A value does not jump beyond a declared multiple between two observations of the same subject.
L20.detail: Catches a 10x valuation typo, which conserves perfectly.

limits: No law catches a wrong category, a crossed pair of equal-amount transfers, or a refund a person books as income: all of these conserve. The eval's truth catches them on Davies; on a real household only review does.
